test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are six friends sitting around a circular dinner table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). E is an immediate neighbour of F. B is sitting second to the left of A. D is sitting to the immediate right of F. Who is sitting third to the left of A?
solution: Given: A, B, C, D, E and F are six friends sitting around a circular dinner table, facing the centre. 1) D is sitting to the immediate right of F. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/045e6f82976e5316f9c7df602faac95e29ee988c1c1a3d57a0922b9330f13da4.png] 2) E is an immediate neighbour of F.
